reason: The label is genuinely clean and zero sugar is what I want before the gym, but 55 CZK a can is a lot on my income when a Monster Ultra costs much less and I can already get YEAHRBA mate cheaper on Rohlík. Every brand says natural now, so it isn't enough to make me switch.
objection: 55 CZK for one can, plus delivery from a small e-shop, when a cheaper yerba mate is already in my Rohlík basket.
would_change_my_mind: A price around 35-40 CZK, or getting it on Rohlík in a multipack so it arrives with my normal shopping.
